functionalReqs: Return top 5 suggestions for a prefix
Suggestions update as popularity changes (daily or hourly)
hints: A trie lets you walk a prefix, but finding the top 5 under a node can be slow. How do you make it O(prefix length)?
Store the precomputed top-k list at every trie node, and separate the read path (serving) from the write path (aggregating logs).

Log queries → batch aggregation (e.g., weekly/daily with MapReduce or Spark) → build trie offline → store in a trie DB or KV of prefix → top-k → shard by prefix range → cache in memory and in the browser; filter layer for blocked terms.
problemStatement:
Design **search autocomplete**: as the user types, show the top 5 most popular queries that start with the typed prefix.

Suggestions must appear within the time between keystrokes and reflect what people are searching for.

scaleHints.users: 10M DAU, ~10 searches per user per day
scaleHints.qps: ~20 keystroke requests per search ⇒ ~24K QPS, 2x at peak

title: Design Typeahead / Search Autocomplete
